status: Prospective design review only; not implemented, benchmarked, authorized release, chosen correction or upstream attribution.
assessment: Semantic map and causal uncertainty are sound. Exact producer-to-child correlation is a justified next measurement candidate after fixed capture closure, but the proposed minimum schema and2KiB-per-callback allowance are larger than necessary. Resolve throughput/lifetime bounds before implementation.
minimum_useful_measurement: Measure which exact producer/router branch supplied each selected explicit slug, with immutable per-event identity and producer callback observation time. Preserve simultaneous per-slug reasons and distinguish producer membership loss from router-added stream-fall gaps.

Prefer one small optional context on the existing g record if a separately scoped wire extension is accepted. A process/link epoch plus one unique parent callback sequence carried by that g is enough for exact association; producer_seq plus aggregate_seq plus frame ordinal are not all required when context travels with its event.

Keep reason masks and only facts needed to distinguish WS freshbook loss, maker membership loss, adapter transition/failure and router injection. Reuse original gap-slug positions rather than repeating up to32 strings. Per-slug masks are required: a global union mask can falsely assign tickerA's book loss to tickerB's maker loss.

If FIFO residence is included, two same-parent monotonic observation points adjacent to successful enqueue and actual dequeue are sufficient. Existing frame/child clocks retain current meanings. Defer socketfirstattempt/completion, encode-stage clocks, broad age snapshots and redundant counters until evidence requires them.
Keep one child slot event/window with first/last observed context. Explicit context omission remains unknown; no nearest-time replacement or retrospective V1 rewrite.

blocking_design_choices_before_implement.issue: Outstanding budget does not cap sustained hot-path work
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.evidence: 128atoms/256KiB can recycle indefinitely; 1000callbacks/s with2KiB atoms is roughly2MiB/s of added wire payload plus repeated allocation/validation. This is an arithmetic illustration, not a measured callback rate.
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.required: Choose smaller fixed primitive schema and predeclared sustained byte/context rate cap plus pending/current-frame capacity. Test omission before expensive allocation; fixed omission counters only. No repeated serialization solely to estimate length.

blocking_design_choices_before_implement.issue: 32ticker facts versus2KiB atom is inconsistent at worst-length slugs
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.evidence: 32*128bytes of ticker text alone exceeds4KiB before field overhead.
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.required: Reference original g slug indices, cap per-slug primitives and mark uncovered indices unavailable. Do not silently truncate a reason union or alter original slugs/order.

blocking_design_choices_before_implement.issue: Accounting lifetime crosses original queue and partial socket frame
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.evidence: _encode pops items before _send; _send retains data[written:] in self.out and repeated flushes may only drain that out. _put may discard events when notrunning/full; _stop_link clears both pending andout.
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.required: Transfer reserved credit pending->currentencodedframe->partialout; release frame-level credits only on complete send or close/failure. Refund unsuccessful append/originaldrop. Do not release at pop or first partialsend. Bound temporary object+marshal+out-copy memory separately from logical payload budget.

blocking_design_choices_before_implement.issue: Optional bytes can cross existing frame limit or change frame slicing
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.evidence: Reader rejects frames above FRAME_MAX64MiB. CPU-budgeted _encode slicing and socketpressure are existing behavior-sensitive boundaries.
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.required: Ensure optional metadata cannot make a formerly valid frame exceed frame limit; safe omission path and boundary fixtures. No fallback that replays original _encode/pop/book-baseline operations. Measure producer/router/link CPU, actual slicing/dropcounts, framebytes and partialsend behavior.

blocking_design_choices_before_implement.issue: Final record ordinal only required for out-of-band map option
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.evidence: _flush records outcome_index before m, then _encode adds FIFO records, then outcomes may be inserted before those events.
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.required: For byte-identical-wire mapping enumerate final items after optional outcomes insertion, or proven exact adjustment. Cover with/without w/k/m/o and delayed outcomes while FIFO remains. Never use g-only ordinal or preinsert queue offset. For in-band immutableeventID do not add redundant ordinal infrastructure.

blocking_design_choices_before_implement.evidence: ContextVar reset protects current context but asynchronously spawned tasks can inherit a copied context that outlives reset. Synchronous callbacks can nest and exceptions can escape.
blocking_design_choices_before_implement.required: Keep carrier restricted to existing synchronous chain with try/finally reset, absent/invalid means unknown, and test inherited tasks/threads/nestedcallbacks. No statusdict private keys reaching live status or persistence.

option_order.assessment: Least correlation machinery if wire extension is in scope; still requires separate parent/live-loop independent review and measured overhead. Proposed first prototype target could be<=256-512bytes/context after explicit schema accounting, not accepted guarantee.

option_order.option: Bounded parent map plus actual child ordinal
option_order.assessment: Use only if exact wirebytes must remain unchanged. More retention/export/instance-join machinery and parentlog work; not inherently safer.120s expiry cannot support5min-slot joins without prior export. Exportcap saturation must report unavailable correlations.
Overengineered for this first branch-attribution question; adds lifecycle/reordering/backpressure/FD/task work without removing need for exact keys.

required_acceptance_additions: Benchmark realistic and adversarial sustained callback rates, not just peak pending count; include exhausted-rate/capacity cheap fallback path.

Test one producer event containing different per-slug simultaneous reasons and omitted subset, repeated identical events, multiple g in one frame, event beforestart applied afterstart, allframeprefix/outcomeinsertion combinations.
Test notrunning/fullpending, encodeexception, sendBlockingIOError/zero/partial/full, oldoutcompletion followed by newframe sameflush, childdeath/close, epochreuse and memorycredit reconciliation.

Preserve original callback arguments/order, cancellation/invalidation priority, g firstfour fields/FIFO, books/trades/outcomes/drop accounting, V1/model/history/state/savecadence. Added observation timing cannot replace decision clocks.
Original valid g must still apply if context malformed/oversize/unavailable; never disable learner or drop original event because optional observer failed.
actual_capture_limit: Observed slot establishes current child first/last effective explicit_slug with aggregate stream and Coinbase flags true. Those aggregate flags do not certify Kalshi-specific maker availability. It does not identify quiet expiry versus book/source/metadata/transport/router cause.
